newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TWO GOALS FROM COLLYMORE HELP LIVERPOOL GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO GOALS FROM COLLYMORE HELP LIVERPOOL GO TOP.

text.p: Two goals from Stan Collymore helped Liverpool clamber to the top of the premier league with a 4-2 victory on Tuesday which condemned Collymore's former club Nottingham Forest to the bottom of the table.

Collymore, back in the first team after a frustrating spell on the bench early this season, opened the scoring after six minutes before England striker Robbie Fowler extended Liverpool's lead with his fifth goal in four days, adding to the four he put past Middlesbrough on Saturday.
Kevin Campbell scrambled a goal back before the break but his team-mate Des Lyttle then cancelled it out with a headed own-goal to restore Liverpool's two-goal cushion.

England veteran Stuart Pearce briefly raised his side's hopes of salvaging a point with a thundering free-kick on the hour but Collymore scored his second and Liverpool's fourth a couple of minutes later.
Roy Evans' side now head the table by two points from Arsenal and three points from Wimbledon, both of who have a game in hand.
Fourth-placed Newcastle failed to make up ground on the top three when they lost 2-1 at Coventry, bottom of the table before start of play.

Kevin Keegan's side were stung by two goals in the first half hour and, although Alan Shearer pulled them back into the game in the second-half, Coventry held on to claim a crucial victory which takes them above Forest in the table.
